repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == false)
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait followed by actions. The candidate polls the sensor at the start of the cycle (t=0) and finds it false, so the guard fails and no action occurs. The input shows the sensor becomes true at t=0 with a 100ms hold (F1), meaning the rising edge occurs at t=0. The candidate must block on the rising edge rather than sampling it periodically (Example A).
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with a rising-edge wait pattern (`wait until(P == true)`) followed by the body and a persistent flag to rearm. This ensures the action fires exactly when the edge occurs, regardless of the wrapper period.
